title: "No sign of Iranian uprising" despite US-Israeli encouragement
summary: Iran's new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei is injured but "safe and sound", the son of the president said on March 11, offering the first official explanation for why the 56-year-old has not been seen since his appointment. contentText: Iran's new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei is injured but "safe and sound", the son of the president said on March 11, offering the first official explanation for why the 56-year-old has not been seen since his appointment. Meanwhile, the US and Israel are hoping to see an uprising in Iran which would dislodge the regime - to no avail. FRANCE 24's Angela Diffley looks into the political situation in the country.
